column1: # Lane name-7 RAM/hardware symbols for fixed P1 [0x780fe, 0x7e540).
# Work RAM is 0x100000-0x10ffff; LSPC registers are listed with their
# addresses so the fix-layer writers in this lane read clearly.

column4: development flag word: retail code only clears it (clr.w at 0xe230 and 0xe3c2, move.w #0 at 0xe3cc in the BIOS dev-mode branch and 0xe4de). Bit 0 = debug hole select: 0xeabc and 0xed80 branch to 0xead0 (draws "NO.   HOLE START" from 0xe533) instead of hole_start_continue; the results screen (0x78d0a, 0x78eb4) and 0x58442/0x5ae8c test it too. Bits 1/7 (0xd5f6), 3 (0x4cbe) and 4 (0x59c18) are other dev toggles

bit 0 = ball rolling (set at $782a after 5 bounces or vz <= 2.0, and at putt launch $4cbe; $5ac64 then runs the roll step $95aa instead of the airborne update); bit 1 = motion over (set by $bc78, OB clamp $5b1a0, $974a, $9544, $4cbe; $5ac64 branches to ball_stopped_state); read by 0x7d438 and 0x7da78
LSPC VRAMADDR shadow: 0xe41c copies it to $3c0000 each vblank; saved/restored around IRQs (0xd4c8, 0xe440) and seeded from 0xa00

per-frame sound_cmd_reply value stored by the frame barrier at $d5b0 ($ff = no new reply, else the 7-bit reply), not a pause flag: 0x7e302 spawns the attract scenes when reply 0 arrives (or after $78 frames), 0x7e39e/0x7e402 end scenes on reply 0; also read by the award wait 0x7b070 (not re-checked with this meaning) (semantic-review-p1-7d4be)

50 Hz flag: REG_LSPCMODE read bit 3 stored by 0xe4ae every vblank (1 = PAL); 50 Hz timer values +$3000 at 0x6e4c6/0x6367e and shorter frame counts at 0x71e40/0x72638/0x7e402 (0x782e6 meter timeout $c8)
bit 7 = once-latch of course_sound_cmd_once 0x58840; cleared on game over (0x7c52c path) and at 0x5addc/0xeb7e/0x58442/0xec0e; not a coin/entry state (semantic-review-p1-7c2d2)
P1 continues used: +1 per accepted continue (0x7c4ac), shown by the continue tally 0x7cf10; $80 = card-resume marker (0xe7f4) (semantic-review-p1-7c2d2)
P2 continues used: same as 0x102ebd for P2 (semantic-review-p1-7c2d2)
fade state: 0 while a fade runs (0xb9740, 0xb97d2, 0xb99fa, 0xb9890 clear it at the start), $ff when done (0xb9814, 0xb9890); waiters (0xf43c, 0x7901e, 0x7904a, 0x79076) proceed when nonzero
written only by golfer_x_offset 0x55038 (golfer +$30 - $40, also kept in golfer +$4a); the target x of 0x79e66 (golfer zoom-in end, shot card exit); 'ball' is unproven
golfer id of player 1; 0xff = unset - the meter bust actors substitute $10702b in attract (0x786a6)
golfer id of player 2; the P2 source in attract mode

shot kind (pending rename shot_kind): 0 at every shot setup (0x58274), 1 = full swing (0x58442), $ff = green/putt shot (0x58680 when the lie 0x106fd6 is 3); only these three writers. Negative: putt physics (skips ball_motion_sweep $95ba, runs $b14a/$b93c, friction $c000 at $9800, hole radius $6000), the finer aim curve and halved aim range ($bdc6/$56582), the 'FOR <score>' banner and sound (0x79f7e/0x79cf4/0x79c34), no hole-object actors (0x2d8a); == 1 required by $9766 and $bc78 snapping; read by 0x7d3b4 and 0x5ac54; not a score status
$ff set by ball_hole_out_event 0xbc78 (with $107082 = 1) when the ball is holed: selects the in-cup step 0xb6a0 in the ball driver and distance 0 in 0x5a8d6; triggers the celebration actor 0x7ac3e
camera scroll step x from camera_clamp_b (0x5aea0), 0 for putts; used by camera_shift_actor 0x59218, scroll_delta_split and the trail actor 0x7da78
camera scroll step y, companion of 0x10d4a2 (0x5aea0, 0x7da78, 0x59218)
the two camera scroll step words above as one long (0x5aea0 writes the swapped pair)
low byte of the hole_number word 0x10d4bc, not a player index: keys course<<8|hole at 0x799ea and 0x61620 (semantic-review-p1-79204)

low y edge of the per-hole band (hole_band_lookup 0x5a19c; -1 = no band), the pair of hole_band_hi $10d4d4; read by the sweep $7eba/$800a, 0x5929a, 0x5aff0, 0x56416, 0x61ade; gates the shot-result stream walk in 0x7a040; 0x7a040 ends its palette streams at the $ffff marker when negative; water-crossing y band on G.CANYON 2/12, FUJIYAMA 4/17, SEASIDE 8/11: ground_height_query returns -$d55 except on $12af cells (semantic-settle-round-flow).

contest record (16.16): max shot distance on a longest-drive hole / min ball-pin distance on a nearest-pin hole; seeded by 0x5a9a2, updated by 0x5a8d6, printed by 0x79476 (YARDS, or m/cm / ft/in); also read by 0x79cf4/0x59daa; not a score
previous value of the contest record 0x10d4e4 (0x5a8d6)

player byte holding the contest record 0x10d4e4 ($ff at hole_load 0x5a13c; 0x5a8d6); read by 0x7b398/0x7b60c for the pose side and 0x6cce2; holder byte is a player record's +0 slot byte (0x5a8d6), so 1 = the P2 record; 0x703dc/0x705dc/0x7079a test it (== 1 / != 0 selects the P2 forms) (semantic-review-p1-6f9ee)
ball actor +$30 (screen x), published each frame by 0x5aea0; consumed by the ball trail 0x7da78
ball screen y published by 0x5aea0: actor +$32 after the z offset (not the player record +0xc); read by ball_trail_publish 0x7da78 (semantic-review-p1-009e0)
word = player record +8 high word (ball y), published at 0x5afbc; the trail actor 0x7d960 flips it by +-0x30 for the trail's screen offset; not a distance
word = player record +$c high word = int(64*ball z), published by 0x5af94; 0x7d960 compares it with the previous frame
set when a round/shot sequence completes (0x7b398, 0x7c2d2), cleared by the round code 0x5ac62 - read by 0x5b6c8
P2 input record, same layout as 0x10d514 (0x60200 merges 0x10d51f/0x10d520/0x10d521)

P1 0x60-byte status block (a6+0x43 in the hole-stock panel selects it); +$44 = hole stock (0x10d572; inc/dec/get 0x5ab4e/0x5ab82/0x5abc6), the only field read there; the +$40..+$43 bytes copied by 0x7ca92 are the panel actor's own fields (semantic-review-p1-7c2d2)
P2 status block, 0x60 bytes after 0x10d52e

skip flag of the pre-hole intro screen: cleared by 0x78c40, set to 0xff by 0x78c98 on an A/B/C edge while the auto bits of $10ebf9 are set (fast-forward), polled by the panel actors in 0x790..-0x7a1.., which then snap to their targets (semantic-review-p1-782e6)

hole-kind bits set by 0x78d0a, no score comparison: outside game_mode 2 bit 1 = longest-drive hole, bit 2 = nearest-pin hole (contest_hole_lookup 0x5aa76 sign); game_mode 2: bit 5 = P1 holes won - lost < 0, bit 3 = |standing| == 18 - hole, bit 4 = |standing| == 19 - hole (match_holes_up 0x5a8ba); read by the panel actors and 0x78c98 (semantic-review-p1-79204, semantic-review-p1-782e6)
1 = the celebration/prize ceremony is running (0x7ac3e, 0x7afec set it, 0x7b070 clears it to 0xff)
mirror of the pose screen's side flag copied by 0x7b53e and watched by 0x7b908 (frame selection); set/cleared by the continue screen 0x7c2d2

two-panel rendezvous counter of the hole-stock panel: 0x7c24e sets 1 outside match play; in match play the first panel sets 1 and waits at 0x7c5ce for the other's increment to 2 (0x7c5b4-0x7c606); no coin state (semantic-review-p1-7c2d2)

set to 1 when a hole-stock panel finishes counting (0x7c3de), read by the other panel's wait (0x7c352, match play with a negative change); not a continue prompt confirmation (semantic-review-p1-7c2d2)

30 entries x 6 bytes {x (0 = empty), y, frame byte offset into $7da26}: written/shifted by 0x7da78 (write offset wraps at $b4), read by the trail actor 0x7d960; not 0x1d x 8 (semantic-review-p1-7d4be)
ball-trail session counter: written only by ball_trail_init 0x7d8bc (addq.b #1); 0x7d8fe compares it with its copy +$13 and ends when a newer session started (semantic-review-p1-7d4be)
BIOS_GAME_DIP+9, soft DIP list 4 'CONTINUE' (OFF/ON): on MVS with it 0 (OFF) the decided-match path at 0xedd2 clears both hole stocks $10d572/$10d5d2; also read by the continue screen 0x7c2d2
BIOS_GAME_DIP+$d, soft DIP list 8 'DEMO SOUND' (WITH / WITH OUT): gates the sound-command sender 0x804de in attract and the VS sequence 0x7e39e; not a demo-play flag
